description_for_model: SamToolbox provides 84+ client-side web tools with zero server uploads: PDF merge, split, compress, convert (Word, Excel, JPG, PNG, PDF/A), sign, protect, OCR; Pakistani calculators (FBR salary tax 2024-2026, university aggregate merit, Marla converter, Zakat, e-stamp paper margin formatter, passport photo resizer); developer utilities (Base64, JSON formatter, SHA-256 hash, JWT decoder, regex tester, URL encoder); and academic calculators (GPA, study timer). All processing executes 100% locally in the browser memory.
description_for_human: Private, free, 100% client-side PDF tools, developer utilities, and Pakistani regional calculators with zero server uploads.
